title: Fig Calls Out in the Hedge
checkpoint: Year 1 Spring 1, week 3 — School readiness — Phase 5: new ways to say and spell u, c, g, ch
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 complete (School readiness) — Phonics Screening Check review week, practising across the whole code.

pages.text: Fig, Moss, and Nell creep along the big bush.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar, Moss the hedgehog and Nell the bee moving together along the base of a long, dark hedge.

pages.text: Fig stops to look at a leaf.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar pausing to look closely at a single green leaf, falling behind the others.

pages.text: Fig looks up. Moss and Nell are not there.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar lifting his head to an empty stretch of hedge, no sign of Moss or Nell.

pages.text: Fig feels small by the big, dark bush.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar standing alone, dwarfed by the tall, shadowy branches of the hedge around him.

pages.text: Fig calls out as loud as he can.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar with his head raised, calling out loudly into the hedge.

pages.text: Nell hears the call from up high.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee pausing mid-flight above the hedge, turning her head towards the sound.

pages.text: Nell flies down to find Fig.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee diving down through the branches of the hedge, searching for Fig.

pages.text: Nell leads Fig back out of the big bush.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee flying just ahead of Fig, guiding him back along the hedge towards the open garden.

pages.text: Fig holds on tight and will not stop.
pages.illustration: Fig gripping tightly to a twig as he crawls steadily behind Nell, determined to keep up.

pages.text: Fig is glad Nell is his friend.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar back out in the open garden with Moss and Nell, all three together again.
